builds.hypothesis:
Poppy smashes the ground, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. 

The unstable area Slows enemies by [0.2 / 0.23 / 0.26 / 0.29 / 0.32 + (8e-05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and erupts after [1] second, dealing [30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] plus [7 / 7.5 / 8 / 8.5 / 9]% max Health physical damage again.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Heroic Charge: wall-crash burst
builds.summary: Explore a large Heroic Charge tackle plus wall collision number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Explore a large Heroic Charge tackle plus wall collision number under fixed conditions, comparing legal item swaps rather than assuming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E has two separate 120 + 0.6 bonus AD physical packets when the tackle actually reaches terrain: 240 + 1.2 bonus AD combined. AD and penetration improve both; a no-wall tackle only gets one. Hubris is capped to earned 10-kill buff state, and Profane active is excluded.

kitEvidence.formula: Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds and take an additional [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
